$comment: Plan de qualification matière F38. Il définit les essais nécessaires mais ne transforme aucune donnée fournisseur en propriété certifiée de la culasse.

candidate.name: EOS Aluminium Constellium CP1
candidate.heat_treatment: 4 h at 400 degC; heating and cooling route recorded per lot

official_sources.title: EOS Aluminium Constellium CP1 material and process data sheet
official_sources.scope: powder composition, M290 process, heat treatment and room-temperature properties

official_sources.title: Constellium CP1 Formula 1 application announcement
official_sources.scope: application provenance only; not a Porsche 917 material qualification

test_families.standard: ASTM F3122 plus ISO/ASTM 52907 process witness strategy

acceptance_logic.statistical_basis: one-sided 95/90 lower tolerance bound where applicable
acceptance_logic.design_allowable: measured lower tolerance bound divided by the documented design factor; no supplier typical value is an allowable
acceptance_logic.thermal_card: temperature-dependent k, cp, alpha, E and Poisson ratio must cover the entire calculated metal-temperature range
acceptance_logic.fatigue_card: LCF and HCF curves must include build orientation, surface state and heat-treatment lot
acceptance_logic.process_witness: same powder lot, machine, parameter set, orientation and heat-treatment batch as the head
acceptance_logic.out_of_range_action: redesign cooling or change process; extrapolation above the highest qualified temperature is forbidden
